title: Writing: Advice for a New Student
writingModel: Welcome to university life! I have been a student at WKU for one year, and I want to share some advice that I wish someone had given me on my first day.

First, you should talk to your lecturers if you have a problem. They are people too — they understand that mistakes happen. You shouldn't suffer in silence. If you submit the wrong file or miss a deadline, you must contact your lecturer immediately and explain honestly. Don't wait — the sooner you communicate, the better.

You must manage your time well from day one. You have to attend at least 80% of your classes, so you shouldn't plan too many activities during the week. I recommend using a planner — you don't have to use a complicated system, just a simple list of daily tasks works well. You mustn't leave all your work to the last minute.

About campus life: you don't have to join every club or society, but I strongly recommend trying at least one. I joined the debate club and it changed my whole experience. You should also explore Uralsk — there are amazing places you can visit at weekends.

Finally, you mustn't forget to take care of yourself. You should sleep properly, eat regularly, and talk to your friends when you feel stressed. University is challenging but also the most exciting time of your life. Enjoy every moment!

Good luck,
Kamila
